content:
{C}Coming from a {G}town in the {a}we{F}st, I'm {C}looking for a {G}place for to {a}re{F}st.
{C}Going down the {G}street all {a}alo{F}ne, there {C}is no place that {G}I would call {a}ho{F}me.

/: So I {C}walk {G}on, I'm a {a}feather in the {F}wind. I {C}walk {G}with the {a}wind{F} :/

Remember all the places I have been
the rivers, mountains, valleys that I've seen.
Thinking of the friends that I've made,
I had to leave them, I couldn't wait.

People say it's time to come round,
I've got to find a place to settle down.
Poor folks, they just don't understand,
I've got to ramble round till the end.
title: Walk with the wind
